response: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has granted regular bail to a man accused under national security provisions and the Official Secrets Act. They ruled that mere suspicion of sharing sensitive information with a contact in Pakistan is not enough to justify keeping him locked up. He was allegedly in telephonic contact with a Karachi-based "Punjabi Kuri." This decision puts the rights of the accused ahead of real threats to our borders and sovereignty. Our courts keep favoring individual freedom over the basic duty to protect the nation, its traditions, and its security.
